items.title: CVS will split up its pharmacy and insurance business into two companies, WSJ says
items.summary: Nov 3 (Reuters) - CVS Health plans to break up its $117 billion business, separating its retail pharmacies from the Caremark pharmacy benefit management operations and the Aetna insurance company it bought nearly a decade ago, the Wall Street Journal quoted the company as saying on Tuesday. CVS Health, which is set to report quarterly results on ‌Wednesday, did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.

items.title: CrowdStrike (CRWD) stock trades down, here is why
items.summary: Shares of cybersecurity platform provider CrowdStrike (NASDAQ:CRWD) fell 2.5% in the morning session after software stocks extended the selloff from the previous session as investors continued to reprice valuations amid mounting artificial intelligence capital expenditure concerns and decelerating software bookings.
